chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sayrafi narrated to us, and he was from the people of hadith. He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn al-Abbas ibn Bassam, the freed-slave of Bani Hashim, narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Khayr narrated to us. He said: And Muhammad ibn Yunus al-Basri narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Yunus and Abu al-Khayr narrated to us. They both said: Ahmad ibn Musa narrated to us. He said: Abu Bukayr al-Nakha'i narrated to us from Sharik from Abu Ishaq from Abu Wa'il from Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). He said:
Ali ibn Abi Talib is the best of people; whoever disagrees has disbelieved.
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being the best of people?
ai.summary: This hadith is narrated from Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman directly from the Prophet (s), who stated: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib is the best of people; whoever disagrees has disbelieved.' Unlike the previous companion statements (19:3-4), this is a direct prophetic proclamation (marfu'), giving it the highest authority.
